q1.question_text: How did you connect with us today?
options: Referral from another agency or person
q1.help_text: Tell us how you found us - this helps us understand how to better reach people

q2.question_text: What age range do you fall into?
q2.help_text: This helps us understand your needs better and ensure we have the right support for you

q3.question_text: What language do you feel most comfortable using right now?
q3.help_text: We want to communicate with you in the way that feels most comfortable

q4.question_text: Do you give us permission for a case worker to help coordinate services for you (housing, health care, employment, etc.) with other organizations?
options: Partial permission (I want to choose what gets shared)
q4.help_text: Your privacy is important. You can choose what information we share with partners

q5.question_text: Would you like us to use a nickname or different name when we talk about you (for privacy/safety reasons)?
q5.placeholder: Enter a nickname or preferred name (optional)
q5.help_text: Your safety matters. You can choose what name we use

q6.question_text: Where did you sleep last night?
q6.help_text: This helps us understand what immediate support you might need

q7.question_text: Are you in physical pain or do you need to see a doctor right away?
q7.help_text: Your health is important. Tell us if you're hurting

q8.question_text: When was your last full meal?
q8.help_text: Food security is a basic need. We can help connect you to resources

q9.question_text: Do you feel safe where you are sleeping right now?
q9.help_text: Your safety is our top priority

q10.question_text: Are you currently trying to get away from violence or abuse?
options: Yes – I need immediate safe shelter (Cornerstone or similar)
q10.help_text: If you're in danger, we can help. You are not alone

q11.question_text: Do you have a safe place to keep your belongings?
q11.help_text: Keeping your things safe is important for stability

q12.question_text: Do you have reliable access to clean drinking water right now?
q12.help_text: Basic hygiene and hydration are essential

q13.question_text: Do you have clothing that is appropriate for the current weather?
q13.help_text: We can help you stay warm and safe

q14.question_text: Do you have a pet that needs to stay with you?
q14.help_text: Your pet matters. We'll help find pet-friendly options

q15.question_text: Are you part of a couple and need to stay together?
q15.help_text: Keeping families and couples together is important

q16.question_text: How long has it been since you had your own permanent housing?
q16.help_text: Understanding your housing history helps us plan better support

q17.question_text: How many separate times have you experienced homelessness in the last 3 years?
q17.help_text: This pattern helps us understand your needs

q18.question_text: Have you ever been evicted from a place in Cobourg or Northumberland County?
q18.help_text: Eviction history can affect housing options. We can help address this

q19.question_text: Are there any legal issues making it harder to get housing right now?
q19.help_text: Legal barriers can be addressed. We have resources to help

q20.question_text: What do you think is the biggest barrier to getting housing right now?
q20.help_text: Tell us what's holding you back. We can problem-solve together

q21.question_text: Have you stayed at Transition House (310 Division) or 10 Chapel Street before?
q21.help_text: Our team may know your history from our facilities

q22.question_text: Are you currently on the Northumberland County housing waitlist?
q22.help_text: We can help you apply if you're not already on the list

q23.question_text: Do you have a valid government-issued photo ID right now?
q23.help_text: Photo ID is needed for many  services. We can help you get one

q24.question_text: Do you have a Social Insurance Number (SIN)?
q24.help_text: A SIN is important for employment and government benefits

q25.question_text: If housing becomes available, what kind would you prefer?
q25.help_text: We want to find housing that works for you

q26.question_text: Have you ever been told by a doctor that you have a mental health condition (depression, anxiety, PTSD, bipolar, schizophrenia, etc.)?
options: I am currently seeking an assessment
q26.help_text: Mental health is health. We support people with all conditions

q27.question_text: Are you already connected with the NHH Community Mental Health Team or another mental health service?
q27.help_text: If you already have support, that's great. We'll coordinate with them

q28.question_text: Would you like us to help arrange a referral to the Walk-In Counselling Clinic on Elgin Street?
q28.help_text: Counselling can help with many challenges

q29.question_text: Do you ever experience times when you 'space out,' have memory gaps, or feel disconnected after difficult experiences?
q29.help_text: These are normal responses to trauma. We can help

q30.question_text: Have you ever had a serious head injury (concussion, fall, accident, etc.)?
q30.help_text: Head injuries can affect health and need medical attention

q31.question_text: Are you currently taking any prescribed medication for mental health?
options: I had some but lost them/ran out
q31.help_text: If you need medication refills, we can help you get them

q32.question_text: Do you have a written crisis prevention or self-care plan?
options: I would like help making one
q32.help_text: A crisis plan helps keep you safe during tough times

q33.question_text: In high-stress situations, do you sometimes feel a loss of control over your thoughts, feelings, or actions?
q33.help_text: Many people experience this. Coping skills can help

q34.question_text: Would you like to speak with a Peer Support Worker?
q34.help_text: Peer workers have lived experience and can offer unique support

q35.question_text: Do you find yourself struggling with hoarding items, collecting things, or finding it hard to let things go?
q35.help_text: This is common and addressable with the right support

q36.question_text: Do you feel that your use of substances is making it harder to keep housing or stay stable?
q36.help_text: We're here to support recovery without judgment

q37.question_text: Would you like a referral to the RAAM (Rapid Access Addiction Medicine) Clinic?
q37.help_text: RAAM provides fast access to addiction support

q38.question_text: Are you interested in the Red Path Recovery Program or similar local recovery supports?
q38.help_text: Local programs offer peer-based recovery support

q39.question_text: Do you currently have access to Naloxone (Narcan) or other overdose prevention tools?
q39.help_text: Naloxone can save lives. We can help you get it

q40.question_text: How many days or months have you been in recovery (if applicable)?
q40.help_text: Recovery is a journey. Every milestone matters

q41.question_text: Is most of your current social circle made up of people who use substances?
q41.help_text: Social support is important for stability

q42.question_text: Do you sometimes use substances to help manage emotional pain or difficult memories?
q42.help_text: This is common. Healthy coping strategies can help

q43.question_text: Which kind of support feels right for you right now?
q43.help_text: Recovery looks different for everyone. You choose your path

q44.question_text: Are you currently receiving Old Age Security (OAS), Canada Pension Plan (CPP), or other pension income?
q44.help_text: Pension income can help stabilize your housing

q45.question_text: Did you lose your housing because a retirement residence or long-term care home closed or changed its rules?
q45.help_text: We can help address housing loss situations

q46.question_text: Do you have any mobility challenges that would require an accessible unit?
q46.help_text: Accessible housing ensures your safety and independence

q47.question_text: Would you like a regular 'Senior Check-in' service for safety and wellness?
q47.help_text: Regular check-ins help us know you're okay

q48.question_text: Is there a family member, friend, or Power of Attorney we should contact to help support you?
q48.help_text: Family connections can provide important support

q49.question_text: Do you live with significant ongoing medical conditions (diabetes, heart disease, COPD, etc.)?
q49.help_text: Medical conditions affect housing needs. We can accommodate

q50.question_text: Are you 60 years of age or older?
q50.help_text: This confirms eligibility for senior-specific services

q51.question_text: Do you need help with meal planning, grocery shopping, or preparing food?

q52.question_text: Do you have a regular family doctor (GP) in Northumberland County?
q52.help_text: A regular doctor ensures continuity of care

q53.question_text: Do you have any upcoming court dates or legal proceedings?
q53.help_text: Legal support can help navigate the court system

q54.question_text: Would you be interested in life skills programming (budgeting, cooking, computer basics, etc.)?
q54.help_text: Life skills can help you build independence

q55.question_text: Do you feel confident in your ability to advocate for yourself or navigate systems ('street smart')?
q55.help_text: We can teach you how to navigate systems effectively

q56.question_text: Is anyone currently forcing, pressuring, or tricking you into doing things you do not want to do?
q56.help_text: If you're being exploited or trafficked, we can help

q57.question_text: If we could help arrange it, do you have a friend or family member you could stay with temporarily?
q57.help_text: Family support is a valuable resource

q58.question_text: Do you currently have any meaningful daily activity (paid work, volunteering, hobbies, routine)?
q58.help_text: Daily structure supports mental health and stability

q59.question_text: Would you like help filing your income tax returns to access credits or benefits?
q59.help_text: Tax credits can put money back in your pocket

q60.question_text: What is the #1 goal or change you would most like to see happen in the next 30 days?
q60.placeholder: What matters most to you right now?
q60.help_text: Tell us your dream. We'll work toward it together
